# Prince Blueblood

The Canterlot prince Rarity dreams of marrying until she actually meets him. Blueblood is a vain, pampered unicorn aristocrat in the G4 Friendship is Magic television continuity, described as Celestia's nephew. IDW's licensed comics later reveal a surprisingly capable diplomat.

[![Blueblood with Rarity at the Gala — Hasbro Studios / DHX Media](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2021/5/20/2460428__safe_derpibooru%2Bimport_screencap_prince%2Bblueblood_rarity_unicorn_season%2B1_the%2Bbest%2Bnight%2Bever_clothes_dress_female_gala%2Bdress_image_jpeg_male.jpeg)](https://twibooru.org/2460428)

- Appearance: White coat, swept golden-blond mane and tail, cyan eyes, eight-pointed compass-rose cutie mark; at the Gala, black lapels, blue bow tie and a red rose.
- Name and family: Initially unnamed on screen, he was called Prince Astron by [early fans](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2011/07/story-first-prince_31.html?hl=en). Prince Blueblood becomes his explicit television name in the season-one finale. Lauren Faust originally wanted him to be a duke and described him as an extremely distant maternal relative of Celestia and Luna, not their immediate sibling's son ([reproduced creator statement](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Best_Night_Ever)).
- Speaking: Vincent Tong voices him in the season-one finale, as confirmed by the [BronyCon announcement](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2017/03/vincent-tong-heading-to-bronycon.html?hl=en).
- Other appearances: Sweet and Elite (S2E9), Magical Mystery Cure (S3E13), and Equestria Games (S4E24), where he sits with visiting dignitaries ([character gallery](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Prince_Blueblood/Gallery)). The French magazine name Vladímir is reported in the [character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Prince_Blueblood), not established as his English television name.

[![Fan portrait by opal_radiance](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2022/2/13/2647824__safe_artist-colon-opal_radiance_derpibooru%2Bimport_prince%2Bblueblood_pony_unicorn_blood_blue_body_full_full%2Bbody_high%2Bres_hooves_horn_image_male.png)](https://twibooru.org/2647824)

## Important moments

- The dream husband — [The Ticket Master (S1E3)](https://transcripts.foreverdreaming.org/viewtopic.php?t=32134), timestamp unavailable. Rarity imagines a royal wedding, setting up the contrast between his reputation and reality.
- The rose — The Best Night Ever (S1E26). He introduces himself, then keeps the flower for his own appearance rather than offering it to Rarity.
- The cake shield — The Best Night Ever (S1E26). He protects himself with Rarity when a cake flies toward them, ending her romantic fantasy. [Episode transcript for both Gala scenes](https://transcripts.foreverdreaming.org/viewtopic.php?t=51825); timestamps unavailable.
- The diplomatic surprise — [Friends Forever #26 (2016)](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2016/03/lets-review-friends-forever-26.html?variant=gle). In the IDW comic by Jeremy Whitley and Tony Fleecs, Blueblood rescues Shining Armor's troubled negotiations in Yakyakistan, earning his respect.

Verification limits: Both images were inspected; full-episode playback and exact timestamps were unavailable, and the Fandom pages and original Faust comment were available only through indexed excerpts or reproductions.
